meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入产品链接或脚本文案,自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想把产品链接快速变成一支宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your product page into a promo video.

howto.what: Claude 会把产品链接、粘贴的脚本或简报变成产品宣传视频：先新建项目并写简报，再抓取页面素材，选定视觉风格，编排分镜和旁白，逐帧生成动画，最后渲染成视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户想营销、发布、推广或揭示产品，或给出任何商业网址时触发；网站导览、展示类需求也走这里。

say.text: 把 https://example.com 做成产品宣传视频
say.note: 会先建立简报并抓取该页面素材。

say.text: 给我的SaaS写一个发布视频脚本
say.note: 会生成 STORYBOARD 和 SCRIPT。

say.text: 把我们的网站导览做成短视频
say.note: 会按网站导览流程捕获并生成视频。

howto.what_en: Claude turns a product/marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video. It sets up the project and brief, captures the page assets, picks a style preset, writes storyboard/script, builds each frame, and renders the final video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to market, launch, promote, reveal a product, or provides any commercial URL. Site tours/showcases also route here.

say_en.text: Make a promo video from https://example.com
say_en.note: It will create the brief and capture the page.

say_en.text: Write a launch video script for our SaaS
say_en.note: It will produce STORYBOARD and SCRIPT.

say_en.text: Turn our website tour into a short video
say_en.note: It will capture and build the video from the site.
